SELECT 
  AVG(invoice_mean_price) as avg_of_invoice_means,
  AVG(CAST(line_item_count AS REAL)) as avg_line_items_per_invoice
FROM (
  SELECT 
    invoice_number,
    AVG(product_price) as invoice_mean_price,
    COUNT(*) as line_item_count
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
  HAVING COUNT(product_price) > 0
)
